subject: Chemistry
purpose: What each role must produce before a spine node moves to the next role. The board derives every node's stage from files and checks against these rules; no agent declares its own progress.

roles.RESEARCHER: Finds and pins allowlisted sources; writes evidence cards; expands chapters into microtopics. The only role that uses the web.
roles.AUTHOR: Writes library records in the chapter staging package from passing evidence cards only; every required field cites cards or is marked AUTHORED_PEDAGOGICAL. No web access.
roles.VERIFIER: Independently re-solves every question, checks each cited field against its cards and the grade scope, and returns findings as duties. Must not be the researcher or author of the node.

priority_note: Phase 6 pilot: the mole concept (plan section 3, Phase 6).
must_cite_cards_note: These fields carry facts: AUTHORED_PEDAGOGICAL is refused for them (authored-practice questions excepted).
